rules.reason: The same definition may be staged at a different absolute path.
rules.evidence: K records Source(<absolute path>) attributes; changing only the checkout root does not change the parsed K construct.

rules.reason: Builtin Source attributes contain the installation-store prefix.
rules.evidence: The release and commit are checked separately before capture; the absolute installation prefix is deployment metadata.

rules.reason: JSON object member order is not semantic.
rules.evidence: RFC 8259 defines objects as unordered; arrays are deliberately left in their original order.
Only CRLF/CR are changed to LF; no Kore token or sentence is reordered.

rules.reason: Kore source attributes contain the absolute definition path.
rules.evidence: The definition digest and all semantic attributes remain in the comparison.

rules.reason: Builtin source attributes contain the installation-store prefix.
rules.evidence: The exact K release and commit are independently pinned in bundle metadata.
Only CRLF/CR are changed to LF.

rules.reason: Diagnostics and text dumps contain the absolute definition path.
rules.evidence: Only the exact resolved definition filename is replaced.

rules.reason: Diagnostics and text dumps can contain the installation-store prefix.
rules.evidence: Only the exact resolved installation root is replaced.
